description: ANY LENGTH clause (a LINKAGE item whose length tracks the argument at runtime), ISO §2023:13.18.2 — introduced 2002
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. ALOP9AL.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. ALCP9AL.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L PIC X ANY LENGTH.
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L.
M.
    EXIT PROGRAM.
END PROGRAM ALCP9AL.
END PROGRAM ALOP9AL.
